## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Catalog parameters of a rolling-element bearing: bore and outer diameters
// plus the dynamic and static load ratings.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling-element_bearing)
type BearingParameters
    implements IValue
{
    BoreDiameter: Length;
    OuterDiameter: Length;
    DynamicLoadRating: Force;
    StaticLoadRating: Force;
}

//==
// # Engineering materials and states of stress
//
// Isotropic material records, the design margin computed against them, and the
// stress and strain states at a point of a loaded body. Physical fields use
// quantity types (Density, Pressure, ...); raw Number fields document their
// units.

//==
// # Materials

// An isotropic engineering material. PoissonRatio is dimensionless (typically
// 0 to 0.5); ThermalExpansion is the linear coefficient in reciprocal kelvin;
// SpecificHeat is in joules per kilogram-kelvin.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_materials_properties)
type EngineeringMaterial
{
    Name: String;
    Density: Density;
    YoungsModulus: Pressure;
    PoissonRatio: Number;
    YieldStrength: Pressure;
    TensileStrength: Pressure;
    ThermalExpansion: Number;
    ThermalConductivity: ThermalConductivity;
    SpecificHeat: Number;
}

// The two independent elastic constants of a linear isotropic material
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lam%C3%A9_parameters): the first parameter
// (lambda) and the shear modulus (mu, also called the second parameter).
//
// These two numbers ARE the constitutive matrix. The 6x6 matrix relating stress
// to engineering strain in an isotropic solid holds only lambda + 2 mu on the
// three normal diagonal entries, lambda on the six normal off-diagonal entries,
// and mu on the three shear diagonal entries — so storing the matrix would be
// storing thirty-six numbers to say two. Derive them from an
// `EngineeringMaterial` with `ToLameParameters`.
type LameParameters
    implements IValue
{
    FirstParameter: Pressure;
    ShearModulus: Pressure;
}

// A dimensionless margin between capacity and demand: capacity divided by
// demand. Values above 1 indicate a passing design.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Factor_of_safety)
type SafetyFactor
    implements IValue, IComparable
{
    Value: Number;
}

//==
// # Stress and strain states

// A plane-stress state at a point: normal components along X and Y and the
// in-plane shear component.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plane_stress)
type StressState2D
    implements IValue
{
    NormalX: Pressure;
    NormalY: Pressure;
    ShearXY: Pressure;
}

// A full 3D stress state at a point, as a symmetric tensor. All components are
// in pascals; off-diagonal entries are the shear stresses.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cauchy_stress_tensor)
type StressState3D
    implements IValue
{
    Matrix: SymmetricMatrix3x3;
}

// A plane-strain state at a point. All components are dimensionless;
// ShearXY is the engineering shear strain (gamma), not the tensor component.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strain_(mechanics))
type StrainState2D
    implements IValue
{
    NormalX: Number;
    NormalY: Number;
    ShearXY: Number;
}

// A full 3D strain state at a point, as a symmetric tensor of dimensionless
// tensor strains. Off-diagonal entries are tensor shears (half the engineering
// shear strains).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infinitesimal_strain_theory)
type StrainState3D
    implements IValue
{
    Matrix: SymmetricMatrix3x3;
}

//==
// # Cross-section profiles
//
// Dimensioned shapes of prismatic members. All are described in the section
// plane; derive analysis-ready values via SectionProperties. Dimensions are
// Length; the derived moments and moduli are raw Numbers that document their
// units.

// A solid rectangular cross-section.
type RectangularSection
    implements IValue
{
    Width: Length;
    Height: Length;
}

// A solid circular cross-section (round bar).
type CircularSection
    implements IValue
{
    Diameter: Length;
}

// A circular tube: outer diameter and wall thickness.
type HollowCircularSection
    implements IValue
{
    OuterDiameter: Length;
    WallThickness: Length;
}

// A rectangular tube (box section) of uniform wall thickness.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollow_structural_section)
type RectangularTubeSection
    implements IValue
{
    Width: Length;
    Height: Length;
    WallThickness: Length;
}
```
